title: 2018 — #01 — Shibby Live and Impromptu (Session #01)
description: Not all of it, there was a good bit of chatter previous to me beginning to record. It was a lot of fun though, I had just gotten home from a kink friendly party and wasn't quite ready for bed. I wanted to play. So I started writing a script... but that just wasn't enough and so I did an impromptu live recording on discord for anyone online to be pinged. Anyways, there are three files in this recording, "The Collaring", "Lemon Stealing Whore", and "Syllables" - the third of which is a full on HFO hypnosis session that turned into "Slut to My Voice". There is also a good bit of the banter in between, as the first two files were full improvs based on in the moment suggestions from my listeners. And without any editing since I want to give you guys a taste of the live experience, the intimacy that can be felt when you are hearing me live.
author: Mistress Shibby
